8352a9ca-22e0-4a1c-bf1f-89f23d95262a.altTitle: Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill
8352a9ca-22e0-4a1c-bf1f-89f23d95262a.description:
Mukouda Tsuyoshi has been summoned from modern Japan to a different world of sword and magic. He eagerly thought of what kind of a huge adventure was waiting for him, but actually, Mukouda is just a civilian who got caught in a Hero Summoning. On top of that, Mukouda's base status is shabby compared to the legitimate heroes. Suspecting the king of foul play, as he's morbidly obese in a kingdom in crisis, apart from being war-happy, Mukouda decides to leave the castle by presenting his lack of martial prowess. The only thing that Mukouda can rely on in this world is his unique skill Net Supermarket, that can only order goods from modern Japan's internet to the new world.

***(Series on Hiatus since March 2026 due to the author's health issues)***

722a45c0-5e55-40f2-929b-ff69b0989edb.title: Who Made Me a Princess
722a45c0-5e55-40f2-929b-ff69b0989edb.description:
Athanasia yang cantik terbunuh di tangan ayah kandungnya sendiri, Claude de Alger Obelia, kaisar berdarah dingin! Itu hanya cerita pengantar tidur yang konyol ... sampai seorang wanita bangun dan tiba-tiba menemukan dia menjadi putri yang malang itu! Dia membutuhkan rencana untuk bertahan dari nasibnya yang terkutuk, dan waktu hampir habis. Akankah dia pergi dengan Rencana A, hidup setenang mungkin tanpa diketahui oleh kaisar yang terkenal itu? Rencana B, kumpulkan cukup uang untuk kabur dari istana? Atau akankah dia terjebak dengan Rencana C, berbicara manis tentang kebaikan ayahnya?!

4980c403-32b9-4a8d-b419-baba79ca0b37.description:
Mitsuru Fujita is a girl who loves playing piano. When she moves into her high school dormitory, her roommate is Kanade Kobayashi, a former rival at piano competitions. She was hailed as a prodigy, but Kanade has given up the piano due to trauma she suffered while studying abroad. Until Mitsuru invites Kanade to play a duet with her...

*Source: Manga Time Kirara, translated*

9ef6e461-033b-4976-b222-943856c94a97.title: Smiley
9ef6e461-033b-4976-b222-943856c94a97.description: Yuushi Kamome is a freelance writer who lost his beloved daughter in an accident. In despair, his wife leaves him, and he spends his days like a shell of a man. One day, however, a flyer from a strange religious group, the "Heart Laughing Society," changes his fate. It shows the image of his wife, whom he has lost touch with...This is a story of faith and madness. What is the black darkness of the cult that an evil smile invites? A chilling “new religion” suspense begins!

757b0671-4a84-468d-add6-cc6db702bc29.title: Kemuri no Mukou ni Koe ga Kikoeru
757b0671-4a84-468d-add6-cc6db702bc29.description: In the hot spring town of Yugawara, not far from Tokyo, Mitsuru Kadono runs a handyman business. An avid smoker, he harbors a unique secret: through the smoke of his cigarettes, he can hear the inner voices of others. Whether it's weeding gardens, giving tours, or offering life advice, Kadono listens to these unspoken thoughts as he supports the townspeople in their daily lives. And so, with a calm demeanor and wisps of smoke curling around him, he continues his quiet, reflective work.

c28acebf-bbf0-47df-96aa-1e6b95f94f6e.title: Anyone Can See It's a Beast
c28acebf-bbf0-47df-96aa-1e6b95f94f6e.description:
Q: Can a wolf and a lion get married and have a rabbit as a kid?
A: Stop talking nonsense, wash your feet, and go to sleep.

... And just like that, I ended up in a situation where I really should just wash my feet and sleep. My dad's a lion, my mom's a wolf, and somehow, I'm a rabbit. Not just any rabbit, an extra who becomes the trigger for a war in the novel! At this rate, not only will everyone die, but both my mom's and dad's entire families will be wiped out.

'No way. I have to change my fate somehow.'

I clenched my fists and stood up determinedly, but then...

"Chloe, do you know what's for dinner tonight? That's right... rabbit meat!"

First things first, I need to make sure the wolves at home don't find out what I really am.

I thought all I had to do was hide the fact that I'm a rabbit. But a bigger problem showed up. Of all the countless special abilities among beastmen, I just had to get "being pitied." I thought this life was doomed too, but then...

"We’re not fighting. So... don't cry, okay? Please."

My parents, who even stopped a war because they were worried about me.

"Just say the word. If you want, I can kill everyone who's bullying you."

And even the original novel's male lead, who's gone a little overboard taking my side.

Honestly... stopping a war might be easier than I thought. Maybe this ability... is more useful than I realized?

1db93d0d-0af0-423e-89fd-ffa5c33ca534.title: Maid wa Koisuru Hachiya-kun
1db93d0d-0af0-423e-89fd-ffa5c33ca534.description: After confessing to my beloved Hanazono-san, I was rejected with the reason, 'I already have an engagement arranged by my parents.' That person is the wealthy and handsome Ikegai-kun, who also happens to have a good personality. Thinking that I had no chance in a straightforward competition, I, Hachiya, decided to cross-dress as a maid and work at the Ikegai house. My plan is to make Ikegai-kun fall for me and break their engagement... Thus begins a slightly silly, cross-dressing maid's comedy that leads to a chaotic love triangle (?)
